questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following metals is used as a catalyst in Haber's process of ammonia synthesis?
questions.solution:
Iron is used as a catalyst in Haber's process.

The Haber process, also called the Haber Bosch process, is the industrial implementation of the reaction of nitrogen gas and hydrogen gas. It is the main industrial procedure to produce ammonia and the catalyst used is iron with a suitable promoter like K2O, CaO, SiO2, and Al2O3.

Hence, Iron is used in the Haber cycle as a cheap catalyst because it allows in acceptable time to reach a reasonable yield

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
The increasing order of acidic strength among the following compounds is

I. Benzoic acid
II. 4-nitrobenzoic acid
III. 3, 4-dinitrobenzoic acid
IV. 4-methoxybenzoic acid
questions.solution:
Since electron-donating groups decrease the acid strength, 4-methoxy benzoic acid is a weaker acid than benzoic acid. Further, since electron-withdrawing groups increase the acid strength, both 4-nitrobenzoic acid and 3, 4-dinitrobenzoic acid are stronger acids than benzoic acid.

Further, due to the presence of an additional NO2​ at m-position with respect to COOH group, 3, 4-dinitrobenzoic acid, the overall acid strength increase in the order:

4-methoxy benzoic acid < Benzoic acid < 4-nitrobenzoic acid < 3, 4-dinitrobenzoic acid

The radius of the atom is about <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>, while that of the nucleus is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>15</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>.

Electrons and the nucleus are held together by electrostatic forces of attraction.
questions.solution:
Rutherford's scattering experiment established the idea of a nucleus, while maintaining that the electrons do not reside in the nucleus.

On the basis of his experiment, Rutherford put forward the model of an atom which had the following features:

There is a positively charged centre in an atom called the nucleus. Nearly all the mass of an atom resides in the nucleus.

The size of the nucleus is very small as compared to the size of the atom.

However, Rutherford later suggested that the electrons are revolving in circular orbits.

25 ml of 35% AgNO3

25 ml of 11.6% NaCl
